meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发发布流水线,把新版本送上 npm 并逐一核验产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要手动跑工作流、还得检查构建产物是否齐全
copy.tagline_en: Trigger the publish pipeline to ship a new npm version and verify its artifacts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you cut releases by running workflows and checking the built artifacts

howto.what: 你让它发版时,Claude 会走完整条发布流程:检查本地改动、同步远端、触发 GitHub Actions 发布工作流并轮询到结束,再核对 npm 包、GitHub release 与 Discord 公告。
howto.when: 当你提到 “publish”、“release”、“deploy” 等关键词,或要求把包发到 npm 时触发。需要给出 patch、minor、major 或显式版本号,没给会先停下来问你。

say.note: 启动补丁版本发布流程
发布小版本并核对产物
按你指定的版本号发布

howto.what_en: When you ask it to ship a release, Claude runs the full publish flow: checks local changes, syncs remote, triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow, polls to completion, then verifies npm packages, the GitHub release and Discord.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention “publish”, “release” or “deploy”, or ask to ship to npm. It needs a patch, minor, major or explicit version; without one it stops and asks.

say_en.note: Ships a minor version and verifies artifacts
Releases the explicit version you name
